t.zh: 下雨地就湿，下雨地又不湿：那就不可能在下雨。
t.en: If rain makes the ground wet and also makes it not wet, it cannot be raining.

after.zh: 反方向，由「¬¬下雨」得到「下雨」，这些规则做不到。
after.en: The other way, from “¬¬it rains” to “it rains”, is beyond these rules.

hint.zh: 「¬下雨」就是「下雨 → ⊥」：假设「下雨」，在框里推出 ⊥。
hint.en: “¬it rains” is “it rains → ⊥”: assume “it rains” and reach ⊥ inside the box.

hint.zh: 「¬¬下雨」是「¬下雨 → ⊥」。假设「¬下雨」，它和已知撞出矛盾。
hint.en: “¬¬it rains” is “¬it rains → ⊥”. Assume “¬it rains”; it clashes with the given.

t.zh: 在下雨，那「没下雨」就不可能成立。
t.en: It is raining, so “it is not raining” cannot hold.
